messages.subject: creating a submenu
parts:
I am working on a custom menu for Deducer/JGR for my students. I noticed the Plots menu in Deducer has submenus (i.e., Quick and Interactive) and I'd like to use these in my menu also. I couldn't find in the Deducer documentation how to add these using the dialog commands. Is there something like a jgr.addSubMenu function? 

Vincent
